messages:
Nora H: quick catch from today's design review — the left filter rail in Model Catalog is collapsing with a heavy slide animation and that hides keyboard focus briefly. VoiceOver doesn't announce the expanded state.
Sam - UX: thanks. that animation was meant to feel slick but agree it's breaking a11y flow. can we honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep focus visible?
Devon Eng: yep, we can gate the transition with the media query. also will ensure focus outline stays on the element during the expand. example: 
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .catalog-filter-rail { transition: none !important; }
}
.catalog-filter-rail:focus { outline-color: var(--focus); }
```
Priya - PM: small copy note — when a version-pin modal is open the button labeled "Filters" reads like it toggles something in the modal. propose changing to "Open filters" for clarity.
Sam - UX: +1 to "Open filters". also add a tooltip with shortcut and a11y-friendly label.
Nora H: another visual nit: compare-table performance badges shift when the rail expands. users called it "jumpy" during the test.
Devon Eng: easy fix: reserve badge space with min-width and align with flex to avoid reflow.
accessbot: accessibility-scan: contrast-issue on .filter-label (3.6:1) and missing aria-live on pin action.
Sam - UX: we'll darken label color and add an aria-live="polite" region for pin/unpin feedback (screen reader will hear "Version pinned").
Priya - PM: actionable list for sprint: 1) prefer-reduced-motion + persistent focus (high), 2) aria-live for pin actions (high), 3) label change to "Open filters" + tooltip (medium), 4) badge width reserve (low).
Devon Eng: i'll bundle 1 and 2 into one PR and include test steps for VO.
Nora H: perfect. I'll update the design doc with before/after gifs and VO repro notes. Thanks folks.
Sam - UX: assigning to me for UX signoff once PR lands. :raised_hands:
